svg.text: orange: busy, reading dead versions to find the live row
every query reads one page, holds its connection for a millisecond, and gives it back
the table bloats. The same query reads 20 pages, then 80. Each one holds its connection longer
no free connection, so the pool opens a few more. They fill the same way: same traffic, longer holds
every server connection is busy reading dead versions. The pool is exhausted and the app is down
221 pages per row. The database is saturated, the app is down, and not a line of code changed
